MASTER-SAAO robotic telescope  [1]  located in South Africa (South African Astronomical Observatory) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 261111A ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 46224) errorbox  24042 sec after notice time and 24075 sec after trigger time at 2026-11-11 18:08:23 UT, with upper limit up to  18.9 mag. Observations started at twilight.  The observations began at zenith distance = 77 deg. The sun  altitude  is -12.0 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -36 deg., longitude l = 182 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3532560
